en:
Kaede...I remember you saying that we
should all be friends after we get out.
You're serious about that, right?
Yeah, of course!

Despite these circumstances, I'm happy to have
met everyone... I'll always treasure that.
...I see.

H-Huh? You don't seem too enthusiastic
about the idea, Rantaro.
No, it's not that...

I would be really happy if I could become
friends with you and everyone else.

But...I don't know what my own 
<CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate<CLT=cltNORMAL> talent is.

What if it's...not something to be proud of?
Or some kind of useless talent...

Or even worse, a talent that would make
everyone hate me.

Useless? Make everyone hate you? How
would a talent like that even work?

I dunno, I could be the <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate Murderous
Fiend<CLT=cltNORMAL> for all you know.

M-Murderous fiend? I doubt it. That would mess
up this whole killing game.

It could be the reason why my memory was
wiped, y'know?

<CLT=cltMIND>N-No way... Rantaro definitely would not
have that kind of talent!
Oh! But the opposite could be possible too!
The...opposite?

Maybe you're the <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate Mystery Writer<CLT=cltNORMAL> and if
your memory wasn't wiped, you'd solve all this!

...But Shuichi's the <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate Detective<CLT=cltNORMAL>,
and he didn't get his memory wiped.

I-I'm sure there's a reason for that... Maybe
you're better at deducing than Shuichi is?
Haha, oh come on! Don't be mean to Shuichi!
Y-You're the one who made me say it!

Okay, you got me.
Sorry, I know I'm teasing you.

Anyway, I don't know what you're so
worried about...

No matter what your talent is, I still want to be
friends with you.

The reason I'm spending time with you has
nothing to do with your talent, Rantaro.

...Thank you. I also want to get out of here
soon, to become friends with you all, y'know?
Yeah! I'm looking forward to it!

Once we escape this place, I wanna know more
about everyone, not just their talents...

But also what food they like, what kind of books
they read, how they spend their weekends...

Oh! And I definitely wanna know what kind of
music everyone likes!

Yeah... Honestly, I can't even imagine
what sort of stuff everyone's into.
That's why we all should talk more.

We may live far apart, but these days, there
are lots of options for keeping in touch.

But it would be nice to meet up in person
every now and then.

I know, I'll invite you to my next concert!
You and everyone else!
...I'm looking forward to it, Kaede.

I want us all to meet again...and I'll work
hard to make that happen.

It's not just you, though. We all need to work
hard together to make that happen.
...Yeah. You're right.
<CLT=cltMIND>We nodded to each other.

<CLT=cltMIND>That's right. One person's strength may
not be enough, but there are 16 of us here!

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Rantaro's <CLT=cltSTRONG>Report Card<CLT=cltSYSTEM> has been updated
based on your experience with him.

<CLT=cltMIND>After parting ways with Rantaro, I returned
to my room.
